executive_summary.summary: Composes 3 FRs with their NFRs; approver adoption is the top risk; 2 NFR boundary conditions remain TBD.
executive_summary.reasoning: Condenses the requirement count, the single biggest risk (approver adoption), and the open-question count — no new claim introduced. Written last.

assumptions.short_title: Employees have basic digital submission access
assumptions.summary: Employees can reliably complete digital claim submission on their own device without training.
assumptions.reasoning: vision.md never validated employee digital access directly; FR-001's digital-only submission requires it, so it is stated as an assumption, not a confirmed fact.

assumptions.short_title: Finance system can report exact payment timestamps
assumptions.summary: Finance's payment system can report a precise payment timestamp for time-to-payment measurement.
assumptions.reasoning: FR-003 depends on an exact payment timestamp existing somewhere in Finance's systems; vision.md never confirmed this, so it is carried as an unvalidated premise.

constraints.short_title: Internal-only data protection stays in view
constraints.summary: Internal employee/finance data only; data protection is an ongoing design consideration, not a launch blocker.
constraints.reasoning: Carried forward from vision.md § Regulatory Posture's Green CON-01 item, which constrains how FR-001 and FR-003 may handle claim/payment data.

risks.summary: If approvers find the dashboard slower than email, they may revert to old habits.
risks.reasoning: Carried forward verbatim from vision.md § Open Risks Carried Forward (OR-01) — FR-002's dashboard is the exact capability this risk is about.

requirements.title: Digital claim submission
requirements.statement: The system shall allow an employee to submit an expense claim digitally, without paper or email.

nfrs.boundary_condition: Submission form must be completable in under 5 minutes for a typical claim
Uploaded receipt images must be stored encrypted at rest

requirements.reasoning: Carried verbatim from requirements.md FR-001, with both nfr-spec.md boundary conditions attached — none dropped.

requirements.title: Single approver dashboard
requirements.statement: The system shall present every pending claim awaiting an approver's decision in one dashboard view.

nfrs.boundary_condition: Dashboard load time under peak concurrent approver load — TBD — needs stakeholder input
Dashboard must clearly flag claims pending more than 5 business days

requirements.reasoning: Carried verbatim from requirements.md FR-002, with both nfr-spec.md boundary conditions attached, including the still-open Performance TBD.

requirements.title: Submission-to-payment time reporting
requirements.statement: The system shall record, per claim, the elapsed time from submission to payment, and expose this for reporting against a target of under 5 business days.

nfrs.boundary_condition: P95 submission-to-payment time under 5 business days
Retention period for payment-time records — TBD — needs stakeholder input

requirements.reasoning: Carried verbatim from requirements.md FR-003, with both nfr-spec.md boundary conditions attached, including the still-open Compliance TBD.

open_questions.summary: Dashboard load time under peak concurrent approver load
No FR covers claim rejection or dispute — only approval; what happens when a manager rejects a claim is unspecified.
